description: Short original questions on arithmetic, reasoning, dates, unit conversion, string manipulation and stable common knowledge.

items.prompt: Mira buys 7 notebooks at 3 dollars each and one pen for 4 dollars. How many dollars does she spend in total? Give just the number.
A bus has 38 passengers. At the first stop 9 people get off and 14 people get on. How many passengers are on the bus now? Give just the number.
What is the capital city of Japan? Reply with the city name only.
What is the chemical symbol for the element sodium? Give just the symbol.
Which planet is closest to the Sun? Reply with one word.
Reverse the letters of the word 'lantern'. Give just the reversed word.
How many letters are in the word 'orchestra'? Give just the number.
How many centimeters are in 4.5 meters? Give just the number.
If today is Monday, what day of the week will it be in 3 days? Reply with the day name.
How many days are in a leap year? Give just the number.
What is 15% of 80? Give just the number.
What is the 3rd letter of the word 'garden'? Reply with the single letter.
What is the capital city of Canada? Reply with the city name only.
Which chemical element has the symbol Fe? Reply with the element name only.
Which number is larger: 0.7 or 0.65? Give just the number.
How many minutes are in 3.5 hours? Give just the number.
How many words are in this sentence: 'The quick grey heron waited by the cold river.' Give just the number.
What is the largest planet in our solar system? Reply with one word.
A bakery bakes 12 trays of rolls with 18 rolls on each tray. It sells 175 rolls and gives away 20. How many rolls are left? Give just the number.

Tomas earns 14 dollars per hour. He works 6 hours on Monday and 9 hours on Wednesday, then spends 57 dollars of those earnings on groceries. How many dollars of those earnings does he have left? Give just the number.
Today is a Wednesday. What day of the week will it be 100 days from today? Reply with the day name.
A runner covers 5 kilometers in 25 minutes at a steady pace. What is her speed in kilometers per hour? Give just the number.
How many times does the letter 's' appear in the word 'possessiveness'? Give just the number.
Sort the letters of the word 'planet' into alphabetical order. Give the resulting string of letters with no spaces.
Ana is taller than Ben. Ben is taller than Cleo. Cleo is taller than Dev. Who is the second shortest of the four? Reply with the name only.
A jacket costs 80 dollars. It is discounted by 25%, and then the discounted price is increased by 10%. What is the final price in dollars? Give just the number.
In the same year, how many days after March 3 is April 10? Give just the number.
How many seconds are in 2 hours and 15 minutes? Give just the number.
What is 23 multiplied by 47? Give just the number.
What is the next number in this sequence: 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, ? Give just the number.
A recipe uses 3 cups of flour for every 2 cups of milk. If you use 12 cups of flour, how many cups of milk do you need? Give just the number.
Take the word 'bicycle' and swap its first and last letters. Give just the resulting word.
How many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in the word 'education'? Give just the number.
A train leaves at 09:47 and the trip takes 2 hours and 38 minutes. At what time does it arrive? Give the time in 24-hour HH:MM format.
Priya is 4 years older than Omar. In 6 years, the sum of their ages will be 50. How old is Omar now? Give just the number.
What is the capital city of Australia? Reply with the city name only.
All blickets are green. Some green things are round. Jojo is a blicket. Must Jojo be round? Reply with yes or no.
accept: no( ?[,;:—–-] ?| )(not necessarily|it need not be|jojo need not be round|jojo is not necessarily round)

items.prompt: The average of four numbers is 15. Three of the numbers are 10, 12, and 20. What is the fourth number? Give just the number.
What is the chemical symbol for the element potassium? Give just the symbol.
January 1 of a certain non-leap year is a Thursday. What day of the week is March 1 of that same year? Reply with the day name.
Pipe A alone fills an empty tank in 6 hours. Pipe B alone fills it in 4 hours. If both pipes are opened together on the empty tank, how many hours does it take to fill? Give just the number.
How many times does the letter 'r' appear in the word 'refrigerator'? Give just the number.
Take the word 'thunderstorm', remove every vowel (a, e, i, o, u), and give the remaining letters in their original order as one word.

Four friends, Ari, Bo, Cy and Di, finished a race in places 1 to 4 with no ties. Bo finished immediately after Di. Ari was neither first nor last. Cy finished ahead of Ari. Who finished in 2nd place? Reply with the name only.
What is 1234 multiplied by 56, minus 789? Give just the number.
A shop sells pencils in packs of 12 for 3 dollars per pack, or singly for 30 cents each. What is the lowest cost, in cents, to buy exactly 30 pencils? Give just the number.
How many days are there in the years 2023 and 2024 combined? Give just the number.
How many square centimeters are in 2.5 square meters? Give just the number.
How many letters are in the word 'overcompensation'? Give just the number.
What is the smaller angle, in degrees, between the hour hand and the minute hand of an analog clock at 3:40? Give just the number.
Which of these words comes last in alphabetical order: maple, mango, marble, magnet? Reply with the word only.
3 identical printers print 90 pages in 6 minutes. At the same rate per printer, how many pages do 5 printers print in 10 minutes? Give just the number.
What date is 45 days after 20 January 2026? Give the date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
